mapper.insert: INSERT INTO points_transaction (user_id, change_amount, balance_after, source, ref_id, expire_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{source}, #{refId}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, change_amount, balance_after, source, ref_id, expire_time, create_time FROM points_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, change_amount, balance_after, source, ref_id, expire_time, create_time FROM points_transaction WHERE change_amount > 0 AND expire_time < NOW()
